title: How to "Skip" Regions in Runescape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: ShadowStalkerTM
description:
You'll still need to complete all the main quests to access Kuldra, but these region skips can make the gameplay and progression more interesting.

One of the things i dislike the most about this game is the lack of exploration, the game is fundamentally about completing the main quest in a region to unlock the next one (which is really bad imo, especially since it's a fantasy survival-crafting game, but maybe it's understandable since the game doesn't have much to offer in the first place)

These "Skips" allow you to access the other regions which let's you farm those enemy drops, salvages, chest loot, and merchants which would otherwise not be available at this stage of the game.

The main attraction of these skips imo, is that you are able to kill the Black Knight Titan basically as soon as you make your character and go there, and with the 100% safespot you can kill him naked with the lowest tier staff (but it'll take like 20min lol, you'll need alot of runes and multiple staves due to durability), it's required to start the quest in Umbral Sands, but the main benefit of killing him this early is that it auto-completes the quest in this area so you can talk to the Dreaming Stone and claim a free Lv. 6 2-handed weapon.
